what: The normally hidden cursor appears stuck to the mouse position with no lag when over an element with data-cursor — for circle, a 32px circle bounces once over .3s, 1 → 1.5 → 1, and for text, that text (18px) sits centered. Because of difference blending, it looks black on a white plate and white on a dark photo. It hides immediately when leaving the spot

options.[data-cursor]: Label slot inside the element. Value is circle or the text to show (”Menu”, ”Close”, ”Prev”, ”Next”)

note: Nothing is attached on touch devices. The original shows only on desktop 1280 and up — to turn it off on narrow screens, use [data-fx-part=Hides cursor] via media

from.where: Site-wide b-cursor and b-cursor-area: the original Cursor.ts (quickSetter x·y px) · cursor-bip .3s · mix-blend-mode difference
